entities.summary: Slava Marlow (b. 1999-10-27, Novosibirsk) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Novosibirsk and Russia. Known in the fields of russia, architects & designers, europe.
